checks.detail: Fail: the shipped village runs below the required frame rate, and checkpoint recovery does not restore full ammunition. Independent ordinary-input testing established the fresh unarmed route, acquisition, real practice hit/defense, enemy pursuit, locked anticipation, contact deduplication, interruption, sword/arrow damage, lethal clamping and death. Fresh victory preserved an uncollected remnant across restart; proximity awarded exactly +10 XP, and collected history survived restart without reward replay. Source and live bindings establish substantive Snaiel component integration. Native captures exceed the image floor; shipped-camera coverage and frozen custom views were collected. Camera-integrity and environment-readability patrols found no additional defect in the inspected encounter views: complete actors, readable terrain/river landmarks and visible danger cues broadly follow the low-poly reference direction. Portrait and pause-menu presentation gaps remain. Perceptual audio quality is insufficient_evidence despite captured output. Adjacent continuity disposition: fail for Return to title, nonblocking. Discovery covered pause/resume, replay rewards, obstruction, death, restart and preference persistence; distant maps, Boss content and unchanged traversal variants were lower priority and remain unassessed. No applicable unbound tester_* actions were disclosed.

required_criteria.requirement: 用户撤销旧第9轮并重新规划同一项目第9轮：以本地 Snaiel 第三人称战斗模板的实质组件为底座，融合现有 village 人物/动画/武器绑定、Forest 地图、任务、对话和存档；按 operator-template-foundation.md 检查源码及历史问题后由真实 Planner 明确源模块、依赖、适配接口和删除的重复控制/战斗实现，由 Developer 实际搬入依赖闭包并接入正常玩家流程。只读参考、未接入源码目录、保留多个控制器、重置剧情或隐藏旧灰盒不算采用。优先交付普通输入可达的首个真实敌人：接近/追击/攻击预告、剑或箭真实伤害、命中动作与SFX/VFX、死亡和一次奖励；适配现有教学、生命/死亡恢复与存档，不复制整套不兼容全局系统。独立 Tester 在当前候选验证实际引入机制、回归和可玩性能；资产与许可保留真实来源，不以目录或旧报告宣称通过。已有 Forest 地图继续保留但独立验收未完成，原 forest_environment、R01–R24、五个里程碑、最终性能与PRD验收均不豁免。

developer_outcome.summary: Exact source reads and declarations repaired while preserving implementation. Fresh handoff boots and observes native movement without runtime errors. Independent foundation review, complete contact/recovery regressions, perceptual audio and performance acceptance remain unverified.

risk_note.summary: Blender/demo-global dependencies, duplicated damage ownership and inherited low frame rates can prevent a usable integration. Heard audio and ordinary-input event sequencing are the observations most likely to remain insufficient_evidence.
risk_note.validation: Require source-to-live binding inspection, dependency import, normal-speed input/state/frame observations, heard or captured audio, reward/death/restart cases and a measured representative village window. Retain unavailable observations and unmet performance targets explicitly.
risk_note.why_now: The phase specifically requires substantive template adoption inside the connected encounter; an isolated health probe or existing hand-written enemy cannot establish that result.

task_requirements.requirement: Ordinary input from the existing unarmed start can accept Isha's request, obtain the sword, satisfy real hit/defense practice and reach a single active training enemy whose adopted Snaiel mechanisms govern pursuit, readable direction-locked anticipation, attack windows, contact deduplication, HP, interruption and death.
